author: carrie_may
body:
i'm leaving avicus and also the forums too because it's time to move on to another new game which is i recently got addicted again to team fortress 2. when i also check the forums there, avicus and tf2 forums have very big differences. when i posted a suggestion there, i know people didn't realized it's just a suggestion and suddenly people are taking things way too seriously. here at avicus, when you just suggest something, people are being very nice here also with their opinions. no offence but, people are being trolls and jerks in TF2 forums like they keep on posting spam topics, and some mean stuff.  the moderators there should keep an eye to those people but then, i don't think the moderators gives a sh*t to them. but anyways, i'm still active on skype and feel free to message me. so bye bye! i'll miss you all!

my ign in steam (for those ppl who wants to add me): gamerzelite101
